title: Scoped negative result: sixth-root phases retain the 14-call connector minimum
body:
Allowing sixth-root-of-unity coefficients invalidates the signed connector's even-call argument, because three nonreal phases can sum to zero. This **scoped negative result** closes that gap for PR944/PR1088's three-by-three target: the enlarged characteristic-zero alphabet still needs **14 complete queries**, and its exact optimum under positive phase-independent complete-query tariffs remains `2 sum_F c_F + 2 min_F c_F`.

The written reduction covers every 12- and 13-call multiplicity profile. Two different exact implementations agree on all **291,600 source paths** and four full coverage histograms. Reversal and transpose cover the tripled-output cases. The six predecessor repairs attain the bound for every cheapest-operator choice and all 288 signed/permuted targets. An odd-length positive fixture ensures the old parity argument is not silently reused.

Only `research/sixth-root-connector-seed29/` is added. It includes the proof, certificate, exact source pins, explicit replay manifest, 6,912 symbolic forward/inverse maps, 24 dense rational maps, 507 semantic checks, and isolated receipt/source corruption controls. **No new kappa, selected-supplier admission, physical speedup, or full multiplication theorem is claimed.** Query costs include phases, child work, access, restoration and adapters; word-specific admission/preparation/control charges remain additional.

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/sixth-root-connector-seed29
```

Expected: all three checkers pass, ending in `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/sixth-root-connector-seed29 outcome=negative-result`. The registered Python 3.12.13 replay passed locally in 14.9 seconds. Both standalone implementations also passed optimized Python 3.14.6 runs. Read-only relocation, source/receipt rejection, unchanged PR1088 replay and selected baseline bindings passed. Hosted CI, native hosting, rounded precision and the selected cold replay are not claimed.

OS seed **29**, complex-supplier track. Exact base: `ef5f39403610d231a0c27e8a6b4f08c10209bcd6`; refreshed main `c5108f0f68d482e5712a8e26a5978d47762dfc16` leaves relevant guidance and selection unchanged. Claim: [discussion #1539](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1539). Final overlap search covered 712 open PRs and 211 discussion records, with complete pagination and no warnings; limits are retained in TASK.json.

Credit Ross Richardson / PR944 (`5dbcfbc63f646de5a1354f6b9760ec03837233f0`) and @martinxxx9 / PR1088 (`b0396aad724fec58630fbd4d13a809c562f18d9e`), whose six words are consumed as pinned data. PR1349 (`8adb25ce6d2090de170e241a170668e8fd7cf5a2`) changes the field to F3; PR1526 (`1fb85dc6813b88483f4f0a359ccd722376acd292`) adds paid root scaling. Discussion1540 changes source ownership. These are distinct hypotheses, and no pending implementation is imported. Predecessor notices and foundational credits are retained.

Prepared by Hanson Sun (@bbMisk) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in research, reasoning, implementation, experiments, verification and prose. Apache-2.0. The two methods were authored in one session; no independent human or proof-assistant review is claimed.
